notes.title: The Hive - Update 1.301 Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/04db4e144263af369d670a61032ca805439b5d3d.png[/img]

[h1]The Hive 1.301 Patch Notes[/h1]

This patch addresses many long-standing issues and implements significant improvements based on feedback from our players and reviews over an extended period. Your input has been invaluable in helping us refine and improve the game. Thank you for your continued support!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]Resolved a major performance issue[/b] related to collisions:
[list]
    [*]Identified and fixed inefficiencies in how collisions were handled across all levels.
    [*][b]Result:[/b] Noticeable performance improvements across the game, particularly on larger maps with more units and effects.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] This fix addresses long-standing performance bottlenecks, significantly improving the player experience by enhancing stability and responsiveness.

[h2]Water Shader Updates[/h2]
[b]Water Shader:[/b] Completely overhauled and tailored to meet project needs:
[list]
    [*]Fixed compatibility issues with Unity 2019 that rendered the old shader broken.
    [*]The new shader supports adjustable speed and flow direction, offering greater flexibility and visual consistency.
[/list]
[b]Main Menu Water Shader:[/b] Updated to match the new system so it now functions properly and aligns with in-game water visuals.

[b]Why:[/b] These changes were necessary to restore broken water shaders while improving customization and maintaining consistency in visual quality.

[h2]Unit Changes[/h2]

[h3]Legionnaire[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Squad size: [b]1 unit[/b]
    [*][b]Updated Values:[/b]
        [list]
            [*]Construction time: [b]3[/b]
            [*]Food cost: [b]10[/b]
            [*]Population usage: [b]1[/b]
            [*]Speed: [b]0.25[/b] (up from 0.2)
            [*]HP: [b]45[/b] (up from 35)
        [/list]
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Squad mechanics were removed to make units easier to control. In response, Legionnaires were adjusted to focus on being fast, swarming DPS units and gap closers, with values balanced for their new role as single units.

[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Group size: [b]1 unit[/b]
    [*]Construction time: [b]10[/b]
    [*]Food cost: [b]30[/b]
    [*]Population usage: [b]2[/b]
    [*]Speed: [b]0.18[/b]
    [*]Life: [b]80[/b]
    [*]Max life: [b]80[/b]
    [*]Damage: [b]6[/b]
    [*]Armor Pierce: [b]3[/b]
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Hunters have also been converted to single units for improved control. Their stats were updated to reflect their new role as resilient light skirmishers, with a focus on consistent damage and flexibility in early-game strategies.

[h3]Worker[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.16[/b] to [b]0.2[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Workers were made faster to improve resource collection efficiency and overall game pacing, particularly in early-game scenarios.

[h3]Rhino[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Size increased to [b]2.5[/b].
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.16[/b] to [b]0.2[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Increasing the Rhino’s size and speed reinforces its role as a heavy frontline tank, enabling it to reach key targets faster and hold its position more effectively in combat.

[h3]Wasp[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Angle speed increased from [b]7[/b] to [b]20[/b], improving handling.
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.2[/b] to [b]0.5[/b], making it extremely mobile.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] The Wasp’s mobility and handling were enhanced to emphasize its role as a highly agile unit, ideal for hit-and-run tactics and fast repositioning in battle.

[h2]Level Additions[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Rhino:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 2[/b].
    [*][b]Infestor:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 3[/b].
    [*][b]Wasp:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 5[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] These units were added early in the campaign to showcase their unique strengths and strategies, allowing players to experiment with them before deciding to unlock them with DNA. This encourages strategic planning and exploration of playstyles.

[h2]Level Improvements[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Level 5 Cutscenes:[/b] Two cutscenes redesigned with improved camera angles to reduce disorientation.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Player feedback indicated that the original cutscene angles were confusing. The updated angles make these moments more engaging and visually coherent, improving the narrative experience.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
This patch addresses critical performance issues, improves unit balance and gameplay progression, and enhances visual and narrative clarity. [b]The Hive 1.301[/b] is designed to provide a smoother, more strategic, and immersive experience for both new and returning players.

All the best,  
[b]Skydome Entertainment[/b]

notes.title: The Hive - Patch 1.300 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/d10c2efdcccfc7e624ebee54247896416ef7479f.png[/img]

[h1]The Hive - Patch 1.300[/h1]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
This update brings a range of improvements to visuals, gameplay balance, and early-game pacing based on player feedback. Our goal is to make The Hive more visually engaging, intuitive for newcomers, and better balanced overall.

We’ve introduced quality-of-life changes to improve resource visibility in darker areas, refined unit and boss stats for smoother combat, and fixed a critical monitor resolution bug.

[h2]Under the Hood Updates[/h2]
Alongside the visible changes in this patch, we’ve made important updates behind the scenes to improve the game’s infrastructure and prepare for future development:
[list]
[*] Updated Epic SDK to enhance achievement systems.
[*] Created a standalone demo build of The Hive for smaller platforms, increasing accessibility.
[*] Prepared the project for importing into Unity 6, ensuring long-term compatibility and access to advanced development tools.
[/list]
These updates lay the groundwork for future improvements and ensure The Hive continues to run smoothly.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
We’re committed to improving The Hive and taking player feedback into account as we look toward the future. Here are our primary focus areas moving forward:
[list]
[*] Enhancing Gameplay Balance: Refining combat and resource progression for a smoother, more engaging experience.
[*] Unit Differentiation: Making units feel more unique, both visually and mechanically, to encourage diverse strategies.
[*] Content Expansion: Introducing more units and mechanics to keep gameplay fresh and exciting.
[*] Technical Updates: Ensuring the game remains stable and compatible with new platforms and tools for future updates.
[/list]
Your feedback is invaluable in shaping these updates, so keep sharing your thoughts with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/c50f24987018d2bd5cb47510d242978faaecd645.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics and Visual Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Scene Lighting Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brightened scenes for better visibility.
[*] Added slight saturation for more vibrant colors.
[/list]
These changes ensure environments are clearer and more visually appealing.

[h3]Improved Object Visibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gold piles now emit a soft glow, making them easier to spot in dark areas.
[/list]
This ensures resources are noticeable without disrupting immersion.

[h3]Reflection Probes Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced new reflection probes to enhance realistic lighting on units and environments.
[/list]
This improves the visual fidelity of objects and characters in the game.

[h3]Dimetrodon Miniboss Color Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Dimetrodon miniboss color for better differentiation and clarity.
[/list]
This change ensures the miniboss stands out effectively in its environment.

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Legionnaire Speed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed from 1.0 to 1.2.
[/list]
This adjustment makes Legionnaires more effective in combat by improving engagement pacing.

[h3]First Level End Boss (Ancient Crab)[/h3]
[list]
[*] HP reduced from 3500 to 3000.
[*] Melee damage reduced from 20 to 15.
[*] Cave-In Ability: Cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 15 seconds, and splash damage reduced from 20 to 10 HP.
[/list]
These tweaks make the Ancient Crab less punishing while retaining its challenge.

[h2]Early Game Enhancements[/h2]

[h3]Starting Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players now start the first mission with 1 Behemoth and 2 Medics.
[/list]
This change introduces unit variety early on, encouraging strategic gameplay and showcasing advanced units that can be unlocked later.

[h3]Starting Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*] Food increased from 20 to 100.
[*] Minerals increased from 250 to 350.
[*] Starting population count on first mission increased from 1 to 13.
[*] Population cap raised accordingly.
[/list]
These adjustments provide a smoother economy at the start and encourage unit production experimentation.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Monitor Resolution Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved the error: "Couldn't switch to requested monitor resolution."
[/list]
This fix ensures smoother transitions between monitor settings and eliminates related crashes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know your thoughts in the comments or forums—we’re excited to keep evolving The Hive and look forward to hearing your ideas for future updates.

All the best,
Skydome Entertainment

notes.title: The Hive 1.204 - Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMjYxYWU0OGUxNjk3ZjRiNmEwOTgwNDllZjEwYzU5NjJhYmJiMzJlYiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/3CGwJO1p898CFN80y6/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey all,

We have released a new update for The Hive. Our main focus was to resolve difficulty issues with A.I behaviour on levels 4 and 5.

We were also able to find a solution, why The Hive ending cinematic "The Age of Discovery" would not play for every player at end of the campaign.

It is now working correctly for everyone. If you have not seen it, we recommend completing the last level again!

Full notes below:

1.204 - 2023-05-11 

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Ending Cinematic "Age of Discovery" would not play after completing the campaign, if loading from a save.
[*] Fixed issue where A.I would be too aggressive with attacks on levels 4 and 5.
[*] Balanced out the attacking Chalatoi forces on levels 4 and 5.
[*] Players now have more time between attack waves on levels 4 and 5.
[*] Player starting food increased from 20 to 50 on levels 4 and 5.
[*] Added additional food and mineral sources to levels 4 and 5 starting areas.
[*] Chalatoi Archers range reduced from 50 to 35. They can no longer outrange player turrets.
[*] Skip function now works on ending cinematic
[/list]

[h3]Thank you again for reporting the bugs for us! (no pun intended)[/h3]

Cheers,
Sauli, Toni, William, Dat, Ale & Ville.
aka
Skydome Entertainment

notes.title: Update 1.107 Released
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RUUupaR.png[/img]

[h1]New level up system and solving issues[/h1]

Today we released an update 1.107 that includes overhaul of the level up system. We also added new sound effect for all player buildings.

[b]This update features:[/b]
[list]
[*] All player buildings now have unique sound effect when you select them
[*] Level up system overhaul
[*] Level up bonuses apply to all squad members
[*] All unit levels now have meaningful stat increases
[*] Hover over unit level to see stats gained from experience
[*] You can now see what next level up will give to your units
[*] Different units have different bonuses from leveling up
[*] Experience points needed for unit to level up is increased from 500 to 1000 (to reflect reduced number of unit levels
[*] Maximum level is now 5 down from 1-99
[*] "Ding!" achievement now required level 5, down from 20
[*] Bonuses are not lost when unit is resurrected
[*] Items are now correctly hided during cutscenes
[*] Fixed issue that was slowing the game down when commanding large number of units
[*]Game runs now more smoothly due to optimization
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BQKf81J.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you for being super supportive and encouraging - we are incredibly grateful to have such a positive community. Have fun with the new features and let us know what you think![/h1]

Cheers,
Sauli, Niko, Tero, Santeri, Akseli & Jenni
aka
Skydome Entertainment

notes.title: The Hive release date is August 25th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9d4d4Kp.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Hive release date is August 25th![/h1]

Hello everyone,

We have been working on The Hive for two years on Early Access, we are happy to announce that it's now ready for full release on Steam.

Steam release date has been set to [b]August 25th 2016[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VZjBpLu.jpg[/img]

[h1]Development[/h1]

Idea for The Hive was born ten years ago, I was reading a novel about humans who discover caverns of hell beneath pasific ocean and send expedition to research them.

Gameplay wise games like Homeworld and Dawn of War series have been huge inspiration to us.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tFLkHb3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Future[/h1]

With Community support we would also love to continue the series with Human Campaign

We have also been working on two other games alongside The Hive.

First is Half-life 2 modification called "Joutomaa"

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=372020592
Second one is 2D To-Be-Announced digging game that has randomly generated levels

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4DBQzZv.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fan Support[/h1]

We also want to thank the support from our Early Access adopters who've provided us with great feedback, brilliant suggestions, and dedicated game testing reports.

It warms my heart to see people that tried 0.01 version two years ago (our Early Access launch) are still playing The Hive today and providing feedback on new content.

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

All the best
~Sauli

notes.title: The Hive 0.14 - Unity 5 update is now available
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZZMhNQp.png[/img]

[h1] The Hive  0.14 - Unity 5 update is now available [/h1]

Hello everyone, today we are releasing update 0.14 for The Hive

Our plan for this update was to upgrade whole project from Unity 4 to Unity 5.3.4p2 version,
We also wanted to focus on fixing known bugs and improve certain boss fights.


[h1] Bug fixes & Features: [/h1]

[list]
    [*]Whole project upgraded to use Unity 5 engine
    [*]Shadows are now enabled on all levels on default
    [*]95% of all shaders now use new one
    [*]Lights on every level optimized and changed
    [*]Camera movement speed increased 1 -> 1.5
    [*]Units no longer get stuck underground
    [*]Better pathfinding
    [*]More abilities added to ????
    [*]More special monsters added
    [*]Queen attack now has a slightly larger range and quicker attack speed
    [*]Second mission ambush units are now stronger
    [*]Powerfield and Necromancer skills fixed
    [*]"Under attack" audio no longer plays during cutscene
    [*]Egg laying mechanism fixed
    [*]Music volume level is now same if another song starts
    [*]"Shadow" units have more hp
    [*]Hive and barracks both increase population cap
    [*]Worker den increases worker build cap by 2
    [*]Attackmove bug fixed
    [*]Right clicking on unit no longer deselects its target circle
    [*]You can no longer shift select multiple enemy units
    [*]Retreat button now has small cooldown to prevent spamming it
    [*]Shader issues related to transfer fixed

[h1] Please leave feedback on the new changes! [/h1]

Best of wishes

~Sauli

Hello everyone, today we are releasing update 0.122 for The Hive

Our plan for this update was to fix bugs, add new gui information and new kind of stats to items


[h1] Bug fixes & Features: [/h1]

[list]
    [*]New item properties
    [*]Critical strike - Deal double damage 
    [*]Poison - Deal 40% additional damage over 4 seconds
    [*]Maim - Lower targets damage by 30% for 5 seconds
    [*]Life Leech - Gain a % of damage done as health
    [*]Armor pierce - Ignore X defence
    [*]Reflect - Return X damage when hit
    [*]Unit selection now has highlight on middle gui
    [*]Double clicking unit on middle gui selects it
    [*]Construction bar size fixed
    [*]New font added to options, loadingscreen and ingame
    [*]Medic skill cooldowns are longer
    [*]Maps now have more enemy patrols
    [*]Enemy patrols show in the minimap
    [*]Attack damage removed from levelup
    [*]Tab selection fixed
    [*]Boss names changed
    [*]Resources renamed to Minerals
    [*]Middle gui now shows tooltip on Food, mineral, population and dna
    [*]Insectoid eggs added to the first spawning pool
[/list]
    
[h1] Please leave feedback on the new changes! [/h1]

Best of wishes

~Sauli

notes.title: The Hive - Content patch 0.04 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/28FYg4C.jpg[/img] 

Hello everyone, for patch 0.04 we have been focusing on adding more features and fixing
issues reported by the community. One of the special things we added are Steam Tradings Cards that reward the community.

As always we thank everyone for the important feedback!

---

[h1] Bug fixes & Features: [/h1]

[list]
    [*]Steam Trading Cards
    [*]Middle GUI information added
    [*]Middle GUI prepared for item drops and gear
    [*]Middle GUI now shows the target attack damage and armor
    [*]Buildings now have unit production queue
    [*]New Wildlife creature sounds added
    [*]Several sound effects added
    [*]Economy balancing
    [*]Units now cost more resources
    [*]Food counts increased
    [*]Unit balancing
    [*]Units should no longer freeze
    [*]A.I improved
    [*]Units now have mass which affects if they can be pushed by other units
    [*]units now reset aggro if you kite them too far
    [*]Units now have correct building count timers
    [*]Camera movement improved around map edges, no more stuttering
    [*]Dead units respawn from the dead when healing, replenishing squads cost food
    [*]Slowpoke Hive Queen was buffed and now has more speed, health and damage
    [*]Minimap offset in second map is now fixed
    [*]Minimap optimizing
    [*]Terrain adjustments on both maps to avoid units getting stuck
    [*]You can no longer win and lose the map at the same time
    [*]Salvage units now have more hp and wont be killed instantly
    [*]decreased volume on combat sounds that were too loud
    [*]Lizardman speed and sight radius increased
    [*]Hotkeys improved
    [*]Pathfinding improved
    [*]Unit hpbar locations adjusted
    [*]Turtle speed buffed
    [*]Worker now has sound effects
    [*]Hunter now has sound effects
    [*]Turtle now has sound effects
    [*]Wraith now has sound effects
    [*]Skeleton King selection circle is fixed
    [*]New music playing on game over

---

Best of wishes and keep the feedback coming!

~Sauli

notes.title: The Hive - Content patch 0.03 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wtm2ww0.png[/img]

[h1] The Hive - Content patch 0.03 [/h1]

Hello everyone, this is the first major optimizing and bugfixing content patch for The Hive, while we prepare for the launch of "The Great Wastelands" Again we thank you for all the feedback provided and bug reports. We are also prepairing to launch our other title "Joutomaa" on Steam. I will post more information about patch 0.04 update and new features in the future.

---

[h1] Bug fixes & Features: [/h1]

[list]
    [*]Major optimizing on the game
    [*]Code optimizing
    [*]Pathfinding fixes, units should no longer get stuck on terrain in "Tomb of Ara'desh"
    [*]King Ara'desh rotation is now fixed and the boss is easier to target
    [*]King Ara'desh selection circles fixed
    [*]Several sound effects added
    [*]Workerden should not be able to build units
    [*]Restart button 
    [*]Spellchecking
    [*]Reduced waiting time on Lavagolem cutscene
    [*]InGameMenu Exit returns to main menu instead of desktop
    [*]Mission can't be failed and completed at the same time anymore
    [*]Added sound effect when Ara'desh burrial coffin opens
    [*]Tooltips in Pools of Reflection now show right information
    [*]Continue button fixed in Pools of Reflection
    [*]Time until next update text is disabled when on loading screen
    [*]Torches have light sound
    [*]Workerden does not increase populationcap
    [*]Added soundeffects to map02 Doors
    [*]Tomb of Ara'desh the "I can hear the statue grinding" cutscene is now playing correctly if you insert both items on to the statue at the same time.
    [*]stops all other music/sound in Tomb of Ara'desh final cutscene right before Complete sound starts.
    [*]Fixed Credits sound design part.

---

Best of wishes and keep the feedback coming!

~Sauli
